cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
project(diskann_read_validation LANGUAGES C CXX)
if(NOT ZVEC_SOURCE_DIR)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "ZVEC_SOURCE_DIR is required")
endif()
set(PROJECT_ROOT_DIR ${ZVEC_SOURCE_DIR})
if(NOT ZVEC_DEPS_ROOT)
  set(ZVEC_DEPS_ROOT ${ZVEC_SOURCE_DIR})
endif()
set(CC_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(BUILD_ZVEC_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_ZVEC_CORE_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_ZVEC_AILEGO_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(RABITQ_SUPPORTED OFF)
set(DISKANN_SUPPORTED ON)
add_compile_definitions(DISKANN_SUPPORTED=1 RABITQ_SUPPORTED=0)
include_directories(${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR} ${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/src/include ${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/src)
include(${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/cmake/bazel.cmake)
include(${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/cmake/option.cmake)
include(${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/cmake/utils.cmake)
include(${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/cmake/version.cmake)
set(EXTERNAL_LIB_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/external)
add_subdirectory(${ZVEC_DEPS_ROOT}/thirdparty/sparsehash sparsehash EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory(${ZVEC_DEPS_ROOT}/thirdparty/magic_enum magic_enum EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory(${ZVEC_DEPS_ROOT}/thirdparty/RaBitQ-Library rabitq EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory(${ZVEC_DEPS_ROOT}/thirdparty/googletest googletest EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory(${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/src/ailego ailego EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory(${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/src/turbo turbo EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory(${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/src/core core EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
enable_testing()
set(READER_TEST diskann_file_reader_test)
if(WIN32)
  set(READER_TEST diskann_file_reader_windows_test)
endif()
foreach(name ${READER_TEST} diskann_cache_test)
  cc_gtest(NAME ${name} STRICT LIBS zvec_ailego core_framework core_utility core_metric core_quantizer core_knn_cluster core_knn_diskann
    SRCS ${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/tests/core/algorithm/diskann/${name}.cc
    INCS ${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/src/core ${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/src/core/algorithm/diskann)
endforeach()
cc_gtest(NAME diskann_read_bench STRICT LIBS zvec_core zvec_ailego
  SRCS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/diskann_read_bench.cc
  INCS ${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/src/core ${PROJECT_ROOT_DIR}/src/core/algorithm/diskann)
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(diskann_read_bench PRIVATE psapi)
endif()
